counts_to_countrate — REPRCONV algebra op

• Data kinds: counts → countrate

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.counts_to_countrate(counts, gate_s=0.001) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import reprconv; reprconv.counts_to_countrate(counts, gate_s=0.001), registry से लेना हो तो opsreprconv.get("counts_to_countrate"))

उपयोग

गिनती → count rate [Hz]। countrate_to_counts का उल्टा।

Args:

counts: (N,) non-negative counts।

gate_s: integration window [s]। > 0।

Returns:

(N,) float64 non-negative rate [Hz]।

Raises:

ValueError: negative count / gate_s <= 0 / गलत shape / non-finite।
